reason: Select only model_design because absolute positional embeddings are part of the model, while preprocessing, training, and evaluation are frozen. Their initial signal magnitude may encourage dependence on sequence alignment, but the current validation HR@10 of 0.65 does not establish this as a bottleneck. Historical multiscale experiments support testing position-free causal convolutions, although their combined changes do not isolate the benefit; retain the current learned residual scales and test positional removal alone.

This tests whether removing absolute alignment signals improves generalization across history lengths while causal dilated kernels retain order and relative-distance information; historical position-free multiscale results motivate this hypothesis without justifying additional convolutional branches. Preserve the current eight independent blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8], learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1, causal padding, normalization, GELU, dropout, masking, item initialization, tied scoring, and existing last-nonpadding candidate selection; do not adopt the historical four-block weight sharing.
